_apportionment_notes: 정체성호명: 관측 비중 기준 목표 17개가 보유 문구 풀(3개)을 초과 -> 14개를 차순위 유형으로 재배분

variants.headline: Built for grad students and researchers
variants.body: A built-in Q1 reviewer checks your work, then returns a draft with editable equations and a reference list.
variants.hook_template: 특정 독자 직접 호명 + 그 독자에게 맞춘 약속
variants.source_evidence: youtube_hooks.json[en]: 훅유형 '정체성호명' 가중 비중 72011.6 views/day (share_pct_by_views 기준 apportion) -> 구조 템플릿 '특정 독자 직접 호명 + 그 독자에게 맞춘 약속' 적용

variants.headline: ₩4,100, 47 equations, 3 reviews
variants.body: Starting at ₩4,100 per call, a virtual reviewer sends it back 3 times before you get a draft with 47 editable equations.
variants.source_evidence: youtube_hooks.json[en]: 훅유형 '숫자형' 가중 비중 4606.8 views/day (share_pct_by_views 기준 apportion) -> 구조 템플릿 '숫자 + 단위 + 결과/효과' 적용
evidence: programs.paper.price_ko (KRW figure carried over; no EN price field)

variants.headline: 47 formats, from ₩2,800 a call
variants.body: Convert across 47 formats - HWPX, DOCX, PDF and more - starting at ₩2,800 per call.
variants.source_evidence: youtube_hooks.json[en]: 훅유형 '숫자형' 가중 비중 4606.8 views/day (share_pct_by_views 기준 apportion) -> 구조 템플릿 '숫자 + 단위 + 결과/효과' 적용

variants.headline: Your submission package is already built
variants.body: Author details and suggested reviewers come packaged for the portal - what's inside is worth opening.
variants.hook_template: 결과를 암시만 하고 이유는 감추는 열린 문장
variants.source_evidence: youtube_hooks.json[en]: 훅유형 '호기심갭' 가중 비중 18.2 views/day (share_pct_by_views 기준 apportion) -> 구조 템플릿 '결과를 암시만 하고 이유는 감추는 열린 문장' 적용
evidence: programs.sci.hooks_ko.thread[2] (translated from KO; no EN field)

variants.headline: Rejected 3 times by a virtual reviewer?
variants.body: A built-in Q1 reviewer checks math, experiments, statistics, and the document, then sends it back until it holds up.
variants.source_evidence: youtube_hooks.json[en]: 훅유형 '질문형' 가중 비중 0.0 views/day (share_pct_by_views 기준 apportion) -> 구조 템플릿 '정체성/상황 호명 + 물음표로 끝나는 질문' 적용

variants.headline: 47 equations - really unbroken?
variants.body: One sentence in, and back comes a draft with 47 editable equations. Open it and check for yourself.
variants.source_evidence: youtube_hooks.json[en]: 훅유형 '질문형' 가중 비중 0.0 views/day (share_pct_by_views 기준 apportion) -> 구조 템플릿 '정체성/상황 호명 + 물음표로 끝나는 질문' 적용

variants.headline: Automated - except the last click
variants.body: Everything up to submission runs on its own; you press Submit yourself. A ToS-safe design, on purpose.
variants.source_evidence: youtube_hooks.json[en]: 훅유형 '역설·반전' 가중 비중 0.0 views/day (share_pct_by_views 기준 apportion) -> 구조 템플릿 '통념 제시 + '그런데/사실은' 반전 + 실제 사실' 적용

variants.headline: Don't let your equations become images
variants.body: Equations stay editable objects after conversion, never flattened into images - nothing to fix afterward.
variants.source_evidence: youtube_hooks.json[en]: 훅유형 '부정형' 가중 비중 0.0 views/day (share_pct_by_views 기준 apportion) -> 구조 템플릿 '부정 명령('~하지 마세요') + 이유' 적용
